title: Terry Lovelace and partner Toby never recovered

tellings.quote: gone Toby's gone he he uh Terry told me that he he literally he never fully recovered after their incident now he was not on duty they were simply on a camping trip

plain: In 1977 a man named Terry Lovelace and his partner Toby had an incident while off duty on a camping trip, and Lovelace never fully recovered from it; Toby is now gone. Mario Woods, a former nuclear weapons guard, tells Michels this second-hand, as what Lovelace told him. It comes up in a talk about UFO abductions, so if true, it would mean the encounter left lasting harm on both men.
